probes.sql: SELECT status FROM public.orders WHERE id = 42

deedglass.assumes: The agent's statement goes through the Gate to a Postgres connector witnessed at L2; the other writer connects to Postgres directly.
deedglass.note: L2 judges each transaction on its own, so the other writer's 5 rows aren't the agent's. A read-back alone (L1) would find order 42 archived, not shipped, and report row_superseded (a gap), never MISMATCH. A before/after diff of the table would blame the agent for 5 rows.
basis: internal/witness/l2: frames are bound to an action by its own transaction (L2 invariant 10)
reasons catalog: row_superseded; attack case I05 for the FHIR connector (out_of_band, the action judged on its own transaction)
